outcome: safety of cholecystectomy at the time of caesarean section
cohort: 50 pregnant females who underwent a combined lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) and were having symptomatic cholelithiasis
finding: Combining laparoscopic cholecystectomy with LSCS was found to be safe and effective in this group of patients, with no intraoperative or major postoperative complications.
